editorial:
Imagine being a bored kid named Topper who suddenly finds a pencil that can bring any drawing to life. That is exactly how the chaos starts here. You get to watch Topper sketch a rhinoceros, and before he knows it, a massive animal is standing right in his living room. The whole vibe is like a weird, funny dream where the normal rules of the world just stop working. It is a lighthearted story about imagination and the trouble that comes when your pets are way too big for your apartment. You will love how the movie doesn't take itself too seriously and just lets the weirdness happen.

The acting is charming and the pacing keeps you smiling throughout the whole ride. While the special effects are a bit old-school since it is from 1983, it actually adds to the cozy, homemade feel of the film. If you have kids or just want something sweet to watch, this is a perfect pick. You should definitely try to find a high-quality version to stream on Prime Video or rent it on Apple TV for a family movie night. If you love owning physical media, adding the Blu-ray to your collection is a great way to keep this gem forever.
endingExplained: After all the chaos caused by the magical pencil, Topper realizes that having a giant rhino in a city apartment is just too much to handle. He uses the magic one last time to set things right. The movie wraps up with a heartwarming lesson about friendship and responsibility. Topper says goodbye to his prehistoric pal, and the world returns to normal, leaving you with a happy feeling and a smile.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves magical stories and family comedies.
